Incomplete — public verification did not pass.

What I changed (only in the allowed file `django/db/models/sql/subqueries.py`):
- In `UpdateQuery.get_related_updates`, changed the related-update filter from `query.add_filter("pk__in", self.related_ids)` to `query.add_filter("pk__in", self.related_ids[model])`, so each ancestor update uses the PK values keyed to that specific ancestor model rather than the child's PK list.

Status of verification:
- The last public regression run (`model_inheritance_regress`) FAILED with 1 error: `test_queryset_update_on_parent_model` (plus 1 expected failure). The run also showed a Windows `PermissionError` in the test harness temp-dir cleanup, which may be environmental noise, but the reported error is on the target test.
- The fix is therefore NOT verified. The `related_ids` change alone is insufficient: `pre_sql_setup` in `django/db/models/sql/compiler.py` still populates `self.query.related_ids` as a flat list of the child's PKs, so indexing it by model (`self.related_ids[model]`) is inconsistent with how it is currently built. A complete fix requires also updating `pre_sql_setup` (in `compiler.py`) to build `related_ids` as a per-model mapping (selecting each ancestor's parent-link/PK column, e.g. `politician_ptr_id` for the secondary parent) and to keep the non-related-update path working.

I ran out of the host request budget before I could implement the matching `compiler.py` change and re-verify, so the feature is not complete and public tests are not passing. No tests or documentation were modified.
